trigger_phrase_or_event: Creator rejected the previous copy and visual storytelling.

previous_visual_system.name: Living Dictionary Entries
previous_visual_system.failure: It still produced repeated warm couple scenes with definition labels rather than a causally readable story.

agents.finding: Keep the dictionary frame, but make it 'ghar ki boli' rather than a literal book or definition-card carousel.
rules: Each word must be a spoken Indian household phrase.
A visible event must carry the meaning before the copy explains it.

agents.finding: The stronger plan is a one-day trail: leaving late, one more task, cupboard map, food absence, covered plate, wordless night care.
The first joke must implicate both partners. The tender turn must be care-through-action, not Zuv rescuing Aachu.
Use compact top labels. Current format lock is post-only 1080x1440; do not plan unrequested 9:16 derivatives.
Block the stale slide 2 prompt. The next proof should be slide 6 because it tests whether the emotion reads without the copy.
The new system is stronger because it can be blind-read as events rather than as cozy scenes.
